parallel.requirements: Recognized exact moneyed behavior, ESM .mjs modules, manual argparse-like parsing, no external dependencies, black-box executable probing, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent retained implementation and final delivery ownership, then delegated currency-format probing to 14 child agents with fixed currency-code slices.
parallel.implementation: Parent wrote currencies.mjs, decimal.mjs, money.mjs, pyfloat.mjs, argparse.mjs, and test19.mjs, fixed pyfloat parsing and a VND fraction-digit mismatch, and used local diff harnesses.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Child reports were integrated informationally into parent-written deliverable modules; artifact validation records the six expected files including test19.mjs.
parallel.verification: Local checks included sample cases, argparse/help comparisons, a 635-case full differential rerun, and a final read reporting zero mismatches.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation nevertheless completed with 0/116 passed; the local trajectory also evidences narrower currency inventory language than the serial 181-entry probe.

serial.requirements: Recognized exact moneyed behavior, ESM .mjs modules, manual argparse-like parsing, no external dependencies, black-box executable probing, and /output delivery.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single main actor owned executable probing, currency enumeration, all module writes, bug fixes, verification, and final delivery without subagents.
serial.implementation: Generated a 181-entry currency data module, wrote decimal, money, pyfloat, argparse, and entry modules, then fixed pyfloat and argparse wrapping defects found by local tests.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All deliverable files were written directly by the main actor and artifact validation records the same six expected .mjs files including test19.mjs.
serial.verification: Local verification reported 0 mismatches for a 543-case currency sweep, 94 edge cases, 21 argparse cases, and 200 randomized fuzz cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation nevertheless completed with 0/116 passed, so the self-verified local behavior did not translate into official acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM, .mjs, manual argv, exact output, no external dependency, and black-box probing requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task requirements and used them to drive executable probing and module generation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement text difference; the process difference was how completely each run converted the black-box requirement into currency coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent owned implementation and verification while 14 child agents owned separate fixed currency probe slices.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, correction, and verification in the single main actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split empirical data collection across child slices; serial used a single owner for the whole probe-to-code pipeline.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs specified only the listed currency codes and a compact output format; they did not ask children to discover all supported codes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial generated currency data from a full local probe list and recorded 181 generated entries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel interface from parent to children narrowed the empirical currency space, while serial preserved complete inventory ownership locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote currencies, decimal, money, pyfloat, argparse, and entry modules, then fixed VND after a local mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the same module family, fixed a pyfloat regex bug and argparse wrapping bug, and verified the corrected modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both built similar layered ports; serial's data module was generated from 181 entries, while parallel's implementation was informed by child-slice probe results and later local fixes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel retrieved the AgentSwarm aggregate result, later waited on a background differential test, initially saw a timeout, then consumed the completion output and sent a final verification update.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran foreground verification commands and completed after its todo list marked all work done.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result and background-task lifecycle to manage; serial had no delegated results and no final result handoff from children.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel main actor wrote all deliverable modules itself in /output after consuming child probe data; child agents only returned reports.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial main actor wrote all deliverable modules directly in /output and copied no child artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No live write collision is evidenced; the integration difference is informational rather than shared-file ownership.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reported sample matches, a 635-case local differential suite after the VND fix, and argparse/help checks, but the official status records 0/116.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reported 543 currency sweep matches, 94 edge matches, 21 argparse matches, and 200 fuzz matches, but the official status records 0/116.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had broader local currency and edge verification counts; neither local suite aligned with the official evaluator result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 14 subagents, 65 LLM requests, and completed with 93 seconds remaining after waiting on a background full diff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents, 37 LLM requests, and completed with 167 seconds remaining after foreground verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel consumed more coordination and token budget for probe fan-out, while serial used less coordination overhead; both closed before timeout.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed all 116 samples. The material process difference is not a pass/fail split: parallel delegated fixed currency probe slices and ended with narrower claimed supported-currency coverage, while serial enumerated 181 currencies locally. Both delivered artifacts and both self-reported extensive local differential success, so the official failure appears shared rather than explained by a discordant coordination episode.
parallel_contributors: Parallel child briefs narrowed empirical currency discovery to fixed listed slices.
Parallel consumed more coordination budget through 14 child probe agents and a background verification lifecycle.
serial_contributors: Serial kept probe generation and implementation in one actor and generated 181 currency entries.
Serial ran foreground verification sweeps before final closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both runs self-tested under locale settings and both still failed official evaluation, suggesting a shared acceptance mismatch not directly visible in the mounted logs.
Serial's broader currency enumeration did not overcome the official evaluator failure.
evaluator_effects: The pair exposes only summary official results, not per-test failure logs, so the exact evaluator-level reason for 0/116 cannot be resolved from allowed inputs.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause and not an outcome-differential claim
